prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1298; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured reports the other vehicle backed into the driver's side rear quarter panel. Police report not filed; both parties exchanged information at the scene. Photos of both vehicles requested from insured.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Claimant's representative confirmed injury claim for neck pain and whiplash symptoms, with treatment ongoing. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Insured's vehicle inspected at estimating facility. Damage consistent with reported impact. Repair estimate received and under review. Liability appears probable in favor of insured, pending review of the other driver's statement and parking lot surveillance footage.

Entry 4: Received medical records from claimant's counsel. Diagnosis listed as cervical strain with whiplash-type symptoms. Treatment includes physical therapy and follow-up visits. Records forwarded to the bodily injury reserve review team for evaluation.

Entry 5: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding status. Attorney requested an update on the liability determination and indicated a demand package will follow once treatment concludes. File flagged for supervisor review due to represented status and open injury component.
